description.zh: 把用户反复提出的问题按主题归组、可逐条展开的页面：用问题式标题降低查找成本，配合锚点、搜索或分类让答案自解释，并把仍未解决的人引向人工支持。它用内容替代重复的客服沟通。
description.en: A page that groups recurring questions by topic and expands each answer. Question-style headings cut search cost and keep answers self-serve.

use_when.zh: 用户咨询集中在少数常见问题
use_when.en: Support questions cluster around a few common topics

use_when.zh: 需要减少重复的客服工单
use_when.en: Repetitive support tickets must be reduced

use_when.zh: 售前选型、计费与账号政策需要自助解答
use_when.en: Pre-sales, billing and account policies need self-service answers

avoid_when.zh: 每个问题都需要个性化排查
内容随版本频繁变更（用文档站更合适）
avoid_when.en: Content changes every release — a docs site fits better

avoid_when.zh: 已有完整知识库或社区问答
avoid_when.en: A full knowledge base or community forum already exists

note.zh: 问题作标题，答案点击展开，一屏容纳更多
note.en: Questions as headings with click-to-expand answers

note.zh: 先按主题分组或分段切换，再逐条展开
note.en: Group or switch by topic first, then expand each item

note.zh: 顶部搜索即时过滤问题，适合条目很多时
note.en: A search field filters questions instantly when the list is long

note.zh: 一句说明这里能解决什么，并提示找不到时去哪。
note.en: One line on what this page solves, plus where to go if nothing fits.

note.zh: 即时过滤问题标题，空结果给出人工入口。
note.en: Filter question titles live; an empty result points to support.

note.zh: 按账号、计费、功能等主题分段或切换。
note.en: Segment or switch by account, billing, features and similar topics.

note.zh: 问题式标题，可逐条展开，展开状态可分享锚点。
note.en: Question-style headings that expand, with shareable anchors per item.

note.zh: 先给结论，再给步骤，控制段落长度并链接相关条目。
note.en: Lead with the answer, then steps, keeping paragraphs short and cross-linking.

note.zh: 页尾提供联系支持或提交工单，承接未解决的问题。
note.en: A closing contact or ticket link catches what the page did not resolve.

notes.zh: 问题列表用 max-width 72ch 控制阅读行宽，分类用 grid 自适应排列。展开项给 scroll-margin-top，锚点跳转不被吸顶导航遮挡； 长列表可加 content-visibility auto 省渲染。手风琴用 button 加 aria-expanded 与 aria-controls，不要用纯 div 点击。
notes.en: Cap the question list at max-width 72ch, and lay out categories with an adaptive grid. Give expanded items scroll-margin-top so anchor jumps clear sticky headers, and add content-visibility auto for long lists. Build the accordion from a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls rather than clickable divs.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group — Accordions on Complex Content

basic.zh: 创建一个常见问题页，包含标题、问题列表和可展开的答案。
basic.en: Create an FAQ page with a heading, a list of questions and expandable answers.

design.zh: 设计一个常见问题页：顶部标题与搜索框，下方分类切换，问题列表可逐条展开，展开只保留一个或多个的规则要明确； 页尾提供联系支持入口，深浅色一致，移动端优先。
design.en: Design an FAQ page: a heading and search box on top, category tabs below, and a question list that expands per item with a clear single-or-multi-open rule. Close with a support entry, keep light and dark consistent, and design mobile first.

implementation.zh: 用 React 加 Tailwind 实现 FAQ：搜索框受控并即时过滤，分类切换驱动列表，手风琴用 aria-expanded 与 aria-controls； 空结果展示支持入口；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion；不新增依赖。
implementation.en: React plus Tailwind FAQ: a controlled search field that filters live, category switching drives the list, and the accordion uses aria-expanded and aria-controls. Show a support entry on empty results, respect prefers-reduced-motion, and add no dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现常见问题页。

先检查现有内容组件、手风琴与设计 Token，优先复用。
要求：
- 搜索即时过滤问题标题，分类可切换
- 手风琴使用 aria-expanded 与 aria-controls
- 空结果给出人工支持入口
- 长列表滚动性能与锚点可用
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement the FAQ page in the current project.

Inspect existing content components, accordions and design tokens first; reuse them.
Requirements:
- Search filters question titles live and categories switch
- Accordion uses aria-expanded and aria-controls
- Empty results offer a support entry
- Good scroll performance for long lists and working anchors
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
